summary: Tango Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a proposed public offering of $500 million in common stock (with a $75 million over-allotment option). The offering is an ordinary shelf takedown under an effective S-3 registration statement; no acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or other special situation is involved. The preliminary prospectus supplement states the shares are to be sold by the company via underwriters (J.P. Morgan, Leerink Partners, Cantor, Stifel). The filing is a routine capital raise, not a special-situation event.
